post.title: How to Create a Custom Short Link with a Branded Slug
post.excerpt: Stand out from the crowd by creating custom short links with branded slugs. Learn how personalization increases trust, brand awareness, and click-through rates.
post.content:
To create a custom short link, enter your long URL into brnk.in, specify a memorable keyword like "amz-deal" in the custom slug field, and click generate. This matters because random link characters (like brnk.in/x7y9Z2) lack brand identity and can look suspicious. Custom slugs increase brand consistency and clearly indicate where the link leads, building immediate trust with your audience. This guide explains the benefits of branded URLs, how they can significantly boost click-through rates, and the simple steps to create them yourself.

What is a Custom Slug?

Every short link consists of two main parts: the base domain (like brnk.in) and the slug (the part that comes after the forward slash). A custom slug is a specific word, phrase, or brand identifier that you choose to replace the default, randomly generated characters. According to the IETF URI Syntax, slugs are just the path component of a URL. Instead of relying on random hashes, a custom link could be brnk.in/summer-sale or brnk.in/webinar-signup.

The Benefits of Custom Short Links

Customizing your links requires a tiny bit of extra effort, but the rewards are substantial. Here is why you should prioritize branded slugs in your digital communication:

1. Increased Trust and Security

Internet users are becoming increasingly wary of clicking on mysterious, random links due to the prevalence of phishing and malware, a threat monitored by organizations like APWG. A custom slug acts as a clear indicator of where the link leads. When a user sees brnk.in/new-shoes-collection, they know exactly what to expect. This transparency builds trust and significantly reduces hesitation.

2. Higher Click-Through Rates (CTR)

Because custom links are more trustworthy and descriptive, they naturally attract more clicks. Based on our platform data at brnk.in, links with custom slugs experience a 39% higher click-through rate compared to auto-generated strings. In the competitive world of digital marketing, that kind of boost is invaluable.

3. Brand Consistency and Awareness

Every touchpoint with your audience is an opportunity to reinforce your brand. By incorporating your brand name or relevant keywords into your link slugs, you maintain a consistent identity across all your marketing channels. Over time, this consistency helps build brand recognition.

4. Memorable Offline Marketing

If you are promoting a link on a podcast, a billboard, or printed materials, a custom slug is infinitely easier for your audience to remember and type into their browsers later. No one will remember a random string of letters and numbers, but they will easily remember a catchy, relevant phrase.

How to Create a Custom Short Link

Creating a customized short URL is a quick and intuitive process. Follow these straightforward steps to personalize your links using brnk.in:

Step 1: Copy Your Long Destination URL

Start by navigating to the page you want to share. Copy the full, long URL from your browser's address bar.

Step 2: Head to the Link Shortener

Open the brnk.in homepage. You will see the standard input field for pasting your long URL.

Step 3: Access Customization Options

Paste your long URL into the designated box. Before hitting the "Shorten" button, look for an option labeled "Advanced Options," "Custom Alias," or "Custom Slug." Clicking this will reveal a secondary text field.

Step 4: Enter Your Desired Slug

Type your chosen word or phrase into the custom slug field. Keep it relevant, concise, and easy to read. Use hyphens to separate words if necessary. Once you are satisfied with your custom text, click the button to generate the link.

Note: Custom slugs must be unique. If someone else has already claimed the exact phrase you want, you may need to try a slight variation.

Step 5: Track Your Success

Once you have shared your custom link, monitor its performance. You can view detailed analytics on how your branded links are performing by visiting our track page.

In Practice: Running a Podcast Promo

Let's say you sponsor a popular podcast to promote a 20% discount on your software. Instead of verbally giving the host a messy link or even an auto-generated one like brnk.in/aB39z1, you create a custom short link: brnk.in/podcast-promo. When listeners hear this URL on their commute, they can easily recall and type it into their phone later, driving far more conversions than a random string.

Summary

Custom short links are a simple yet highly effective way to elevate your digital marketing strategy. By replacing random characters with meaningful, branded slugs, you build trust with your audience, improve brand recognition, and ultimately drive more traffic to your content.

Create your first custom short link today by visiting brnk.in and see the difference personalization can make!
